leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function to calculate the total weight of packages
Construct a binary search algorithm to find the minimum ship capacity
Apply a validation check to ensure capacity meets daily shipping constraints
Initialize and manipulate variables to track current capacity and days needed
Configure the algorithm to handle edge cases like single packages or maximum weight limits
Integrate the capacity calculation with the binary search to solve the shipping problem
Render test cases to verify the algorithm's correctness with different package arrays
